title: Environment style study, rough round
question: Which of these looks should we push further toward the reference (ink lines, cel shading, navy shadows, bright window light)? Pick one or more, or none.

media.caption: All six styles next to today's look (row 0) and the reference

options.label: 1. Soft cel
options.note: Three soft-edged tones per material, shadows pulled toward navy, no lines. The closest to today.

options.label: 2. Clean cel, fine line
options.note: Hard two-to-three tone cel shading and a thin soft ink line on silhouettes and creases.

options.label: 3. Anime key
options.note: Hard cel with navy shadows, dark ink of varying weight, a cool restrained palette and a rim of window light. Aimed at the reference.

options.label: 4. Ink and hatching
options.note: Style 3 plus sparse hatching in the shadow band, faint brushed texture on big surfaces and film grain.

options.label: 5. Bold graphic
options.note: Two tones only, heavy ink, palette mapped to navy, slate and white, a hard rim light. The loudest.

options.label: 6. Painted cel
options.note: Cel tones with brushed texture and coloured line art (a dark shade of the colour under it, not black), palette map and grain.

options.label: None of these, push further
options.note: None is close enough yet; try again from a different angle.
